subject: Azure Marketplace private offer — payment terms & SLA for NorthStar Financial

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marya Lewis <marya.lewis@northstar.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Marketplace private offer — payment terms & SLA for NorthStar Financial

Hi Marya,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Attached is the private offer package we discussed (RWI_PrivateOffer_NorthStar_0615.pdf) — it contains the commercial sheet, proposed SKU and the default SLA language.

Key points I want to confirm up front so procurement has what you need:
- Proposed committed capacity: 4 dedicated instances (m6g-equivalent) with burst pool for onboarding.
- List price with NorthStar discount applied: see commercial sheet.
- Billing cadence: we can support monthly invoicing or a single annual prepay.
- Payment terms: standard is Net 30, but we can open Net 60 for enterprise procurement based on contract value.
- SLA: 99.9% uptime; credits governed by the private offer SLA section.

Can you confirm which billing cadence you prefer and whether Net 60 is required for internal approvals? Also, procurement asked if we can include a clause linking the Private Offer to a separate SOW for professional services — we can do that, and I’ve added a placeholder.

If it helps, we can set a short call tomorrow (30 mins) with legal and our finance lead to close commercial terms.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez

Sergio —

Thanks for sending. A few follow-ups from procurement / finance:

1) Billing cadence: NorthStar prefers monthly invoicing against committed capacity with 30 day payment terms, but leadership is open to Net 60 if we get an additional 5% concession or a small onboarding credit.
2) We need SOC 2 Type II evidence and your current DPA. Please attach SOC 2 report or provide a link to the audit folder.
3) Can you add a data deletion/return clause in the DPA (our standard language attached in checklist)?
4) Regarding the SOW: procurement wants the PS statement of work to be an appendix to the private offer rather than a separate standalone contract. Is that acceptable?

I’m copying Tim O'Neill (tim.oneill@northstar.com) from legal and our procurement inbox. I’ve attached our procurement checklist with required fields (NorthStar_Procure_Checklist.xlsx). If we can get a mark-up back by EOD Tuesday we’ll prioritize internal approvals.

Thanks — Marya

Thanks Marya — looping in our legal and finance leads to move quickly. Quick responses inline: 

1) Billing cadence / concession: We can accept monthly invoicing. Regarding Net 60: we can offer Net 60 conditioned on either (a) a 5% price concession for year 1, or (b) a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of the first month’s committed spend. Which would NorthStar prefer?

2) SOC 2 & DPA: Laura — can you confirm availability of the SOC 2 Type II artefact and whether we can ship our standard DPA with a data deletion clause?

3) SOW: David — please confirm whether the PS SOW can be appended to the private offer as an appendix and how that affects invoicing/acceptance milestones.

Marya — I’ve attached a short FAQ we use for marketplace procurement (summary) and highlighted the fields we usually map to your checklist. Happy to do a 20-minute call Monday to walk legal/procurement through changes.

Best,
Sergio

Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace private offer — payment terms & SLA for NorthStar Financial

Marya / team —

We have the SOC 2 Type II report available for redacted review; I will share a link under NDA. We can accept the SOW as an appendix to the private offer but recommend keeping the payment milestone table in the SOW and referencing it from the private offer to avoid double-billing.

On the DPA and data deletion: we are fine to include a data deletion/return clause. Proposed language: "Upon termination or expiration, Customer may request secure deletion or return of Customer Data within 60 days; Redwood will certify deletion within 30 days of receipt of a validated request, subject to applicable law and backup retention policies." Please let us know if NorthStar legal needs a shorter window.

On Net 60: finance is OK to accept Net 60 with a 5% year-1 concession. If that works for NorthStar procurement we’ll move to redline the offer.

I’ll prepare a redlined draft of the private offer that incorporates the DPA linkage and the appendix SOW treatment. Sergio — can you confirm whether the onboarding credit option should also remain on the table?

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace private offer — payment terms & SLA for NorthStar Financial

Laura / Sergio —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. NorthStar legal reviewed and provided redlines (attached: NS_Redlines_June30.docx). Main asks from our side: 

- Payment terms: NorthStar will accept Net 60 only if Redwood adopts a 90-day exit (early termination) notice for the first 12 months.
- SLA credits: NorthStar requests calendar-day service credits (not pro rata) and a minimum service credit cap of 50% of month charges for persistent outages beyond three consecutive days.
- Data deletion: request shortened certification window to 14 days; if Redwood cannot certify in 14 days, NorthStar requests a right to engage an independent auditor at Redwood’s expense to verify deletion.
- Audit & subcontractors: add clause requiring prior notification of third-party subprocessor changes.

Procurement can accept the SOW-as-appendix approach provided the SOW contains clear acceptance criteria. I’ve returned the redline with inline comments and a clean summary sheet. We’d like to move to a DocuSign-ready copy by next Thursday.

Next steps: Sergio — please confirm which concession you prefer (5% discount or onboarding credit) so we can reflect commercial consideration alongside the legal redlines.

Regards,
Marya Lewis
Senior Procurement Manager | NorthStar Financial
marya.lewis@northstar.com
